title: Dispatch: durable exact-membership model for all 68 rows (attempt 4)
description:
Human review of PR #476 at cd2d6ae accepted the previous corrections but found
one remaining P1: the membership model is not exact or durable enough to govern
repair and prove zero recurrence. This is a CONTRACT-LEVEL change affecting all
68 rows. The supervisor has fixed the model below; implement it and migrate
every row.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.md
  packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts
  packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts

=== THE ROOT DEFECT ===
Today a row carries `membershipQuery` and nothing else that survives repair.
That single field conflates two different things: WHAT MUST HOLD (durable) and
WHAT IS CURRENTLY WRONG (transient). When the defect is repaired the query
returns zero rows and the obligation evaporates — so the registry cannot prove
non-recurrence, which is its entire purpose at eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4.

=== SUPERVISOR ROW MODEL — apply uniformly to all 68 rows ===
One coherent model. Do NOT create weak per-family conventions.

  canonicalId, aliases[], title, status, statusReasoning
  obligation {
    obligationId      shared format above where source-backed
    evidenceKind      the closed union above
    authority         what establishes this obligation INDEPENDENTLY of the
                      current pack — a source locator, an authoritative input,
                      or an audit-finding identity. The pack under repair may
                      never be the sole authority for its own obligations.
  }
  target {            what the obligation is ABOUT; survives repair
    kind              'record'|'clause'|'field'|'path'|'relationship'|'capability'
    selector          STRUCTURED and exact — not a text search
  }
  invariant           stated POSITIVELY, as what must hold. Durable.
  violation {         the CURRENT defect predicate. May legitimately go empty.
    queryId
    expectedAfterRepair  'empty' | 'stable'
  }
  baselineMembership { the audited baseline, reproducible
    capturedAtCommit
    members[]         exact member identities
  }
  currentMembership   GENERATED at evaluation time; never stored as authority
  owningBead
  regression { evidenceKind, locator }

The durable identity is obligation + target + invariant. The violation query is
separate and MAY become empty after repair WITHOUT the row losing meaning. That
separation is the whole fix — do not collapse them back.

=== THE MODEL MUST SUPPORT ALL TEN CASES ===
Each needs at least one real row and a test:
 1 clause missing entirely from the current pack
 2 clause present on the wrong owner
 3 field present with the wrong value
 4 missing branch or alternative
 5 unsupported output with no authoritative source
 6 provenance or locator defect
 7 engine capability gap
 8 finding whose violating membership becomes EMPTY after repair
 9 ambiguous/narrowed finding whose preserved boundary must not regress
10 cross-kind defect whose membership spans multiple record families

Case 1 and case 5 are why `authority` may not come from the pack: a clause
MISSING from the pack cannot be found by querying the pack.

=== EXACTNESS REQUIREMENTS ===
* Reject generic/substring searches that can silently overmatch or undermatch.
  Selectors must be structured identities.
* Reject empty CURRENT membership when the row claims a live baseline defect,
  unless an explicit reviewed status makes emptiness valid — and then the row
  must say so and why.
* Preserve baseline membership separately from current generated membership.
  Baseline is a reproducible snapshot of IDENTITIES, which is not a hand-copied
  count and does not violate count hygiene. A transcribed total (391, 399, 77,
  79, 794) remains forbidden.
* No hard-coded total may be authority anywhere.

=== ROW-BY-ROW MIGRATION IS REQUIRED ===
Migrate and review ALL 68 rows. Do not migrate representative rows and
extrapolate. For each row decide its target kind, its authority, its invariant,
and whether its violation is expected to go empty after repair. If a row's exact
membership cannot yet be expressed — for example because the clause IR from
PR #475 has not landed — say so EXPLICITLY on the row with a defined follow-up,
rather than substituting a thematic query that reads as exact.

=== SHARED SOURCE-OBLIGATION IDENTITY (supervisor decision, binding across
PRs #475, #476, #477) ===
Fixed by the supervisor so the branches cannot invent competing definitions.
PR #475 is implementing the same identity in the clause IR.

  obligationId := "obl:<sourceRef>:<locator>:<facet>"
     sourceRef  stable source document identity, e.g. "srd-5.1"
     locator    source anchor, e.g. "p.104#fireball"
     facet      semantic facet name

EVIDENCE KIND is a closed union. Never overload one "sourceSpan" field to carry
incompatible evidence types:
  'source-span' | 'authoritative-input' | 'audit-finding' | 'code' | 'bead'
  | 'known-missing-source-clause'

DO NOT import code from the #475 branch — it is unfinished and on another
branch. Duplicate the small identity/evidence types locally, and record the
intentional temporary duplication plus the follow-up integration boundary in
finding-registry.md.

=== finding-registry.md ===
Document the model, the ten cases, the durable-vs-transient separation, the
authority rule, and the cross-PR identity with its deferred integration
boundary. The JSON stays the single source of truth; the .md must not restate
row data that could drift.

=== ENVIRONMENT AND VERIFICATION ===
Run `npm ci` FIRST. Run `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing — it
rewrites files. If rulesPackAuditCli or dolt-gated suites time out under load,
rerun that file in isolation before concluding a regression.

=== HARD CONSTRAINTS ===
* Edit ONLY the files under FILES YOU OWN. Do not touch package.json,
  packages/core/package.json, packages/core/src/internal.ts, AGENTS.md,
  CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/protocol/CI file. Review infrastructure is
  explicitly OUT OF SCOPE this session.
* Do NOT regenerate the rules pack, run the importer, or edit packages/core/data.
* Do NOT modify any bead except your own. Do NOT run `bd dolt push`.
* Do NOT push, open/comment on a PR, or merge.
* PRESERVE and do not regress the three previously accepted corrections:
  indep:011 reclassified with its extension boundary; indep:001 and sol:CAP-001
  separated; duplicate canonicalId rejected via a real Set with mutation
  coverage. Keep their tests.
* Where a committed test encodes defective behavior, change it deliberately and
  record why. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• One coherent row model applied to all 68 rows; no per-family weak conventions.
• Durable obligation identity (obligation + target + invariant) is separate from the transient violation predicate; a repaired row keeps its meaning with empty violation membership.
• Row authority is independent of the pack under repair; missing-clause and unsupported-output findings are grounded outside it.
• All ten listed cases are represented by real rows and covered by tests.
• Selectors are structured and exact; generic/substring matching is rejected with negative tests.
• Baseline membership snapshot is preserved and distinct from generated current membership; no hard-coded total is authority.
• Unexpectedly empty current membership fails unless an explicit reviewed status justifies it.
• Rows whose exact membership cannot yet be expressed say so explicitly with a follow-up, rather than substituting a thematic query.
• indep:011, the indep:001/sol:CAP-001 split, and duplicate-canonicalId rejection are preserved with their tests.
• All 70 aliases still resolve to exactly one canonical row.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
